blockingFindings.title: dependency-cruiser orphan semantics do not prove production-root unreachability
blockingFindings.requiredRevision: Add a decisive internally-connected dead-subgraph fixture and prove a bounded production-root reachability check catches it, or explicitly narrow the contract to isolated orphan modules and justify that narrower capability. Do not reopen the valid Knip dependency-only branch or expand into a graph platform.

revisionGuidance: Keep Knip restricted to unused direct package declarations; that proof is accepted.
Replace or narrow the orphan-production-source proof so mechanical semantics equal the stated contract.
Required counterexample: an internally connected production subgraph unreachable from both explicit production roots must fail.
Prefer a small bounded root-reachability proof rather than a new registry/platform.
Do not add unused exports/types, baseline/waiver/cache, changed-file planning, or merge entropy into dependency-health.
